knowledge_base.text: [DEMO] LabQueue is a scheduling tool for shared university lab equipment. Students currently book microscopes and centrifuges on a paper sign-up sheet outside each room.
[DEMO] We ran a pilot in one materials science building for six weeks. 40 students used it. Average wait time for a microscope dropped, and we stopped 12 double-bookings.
[DEMO] We interviewed 12 lab managers across 4 departments before building anything. All 12 said equipment conflicts were a weekly problem.
[DEMO] Two undergraduates, both third-year. One writes the software, one runs the pilot and talks to lab managers. Neither has a faculty advisor yet.
[DEMO] No legal entity has been formed. No revenue. No outside funding of any kind so far.
[DEMO] The next step is running the pilot in two more buildings and handling authentication against the university directory.
